run_evaluate_all: run evaluate_all to evaluate box detection, instance segmentation, and keypoint detection on a dataset
run_evaluate_boxes: run evaluate_boxes to evaluate bounding box detection results for a COCO or VOC dataset
run_evaluate_masks: run evaluate_masks to evaluate instance segmentation results for a COCO or Cityscapes dataset
run_evaluate_keypoints: run evaluate_keypoints to evaluate human keypoint detection results for a COCO keypoints dataset
run_check_expected_results: run check_expected_results to compare actual evaluation results against expected results stored in cfg
